headline: How does he really feel about me?
note: Face-down only (return-mhf). 🔄 REWRITTEN 2026-08-19 to the Natural Tarot-Cut framework, after the interior ban was loosened. The read may now ANSWER: the card carries the claim about him. 🔴 THE DENIAL IS STILL BANNED — 'he does not love you' is the one direction she has no use for. 🔴 NO DIAGNOSIS: avoidant, emotionally unavailable, commitment-phobic, narcissist. 🔴 Never grade her (naive, foolish, gave too much). 🔴 No dates. The seven cuts run as ONE causal chain — so / and / but / that's why / let me look closer — and every cut must add information the last one did not carry.

a: You turned the Magician, dear. Look — the four things on the table are all within his reach.
You asked how he really feels about you. Your hand went to the card of a man who chooses.
So he feels it, dear. The card is plain with me about that.
And he has chosen how much of it reaches you. That choosing is done on purpose.
But choosing what to show you is not the same as feeling less.
That's why he can seem near one day, dear, and measured the next.
Let me look closer at what sits behind the part he keeps back…
b: You turned the Hanged Man, dear. Look — his face is the lowest thing on the card.
You asked how he really feels about you. Your hand went to the card of a man seen upside down.
So he does feel it, dear. You've been picking that up correctly.
And there is more of it in him than that angle has let you see.
But hanging there, he cannot turn himself the right way up.
That's why you keep getting halves of him, dear, and never the whole.
Let me look closer at what has been holding him in that position…
c: You turned the Fool, dear. Look — the dog is barking and he hasn't turned round.
You asked how he really feels about you. Your hand went to the card of a man mid-step.
So he feels it, dear. What you picked up from him was there.
And this card walks on without once looking back at what it left.
But walking on is a habit in him. It is not a ruling on you.
That's why the warmth reached you, dear, and the account never did.
Let me look closer at what keeps him from stopping long enough…
